name: Yellow Pitcherplant
desc: Yellow Pitcherplant (Sarracenia flava): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 156 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Sarracenia flava, the yellow pitcherplant, is a carnivorous plant in the family Sarraceniaceae. Like all the Sarraceniaceae, it is native to the New World.
